$comment: Allowlisted, parameterized SQL operations. Clients call these by name at POST /v1/op/:name and never send SQL. Each op declares its params (name -> type), the param used to pick a shard (shardBy), and mode (read|write). Add operations here; nothing else is executable. Users and their orders both shard by the user id, so they co-locate on the same shard.

get_user.sql: SELECT id, username, email, created_at FROM dbo.Users WHERE id = @id

create_user.sql: INSERT INTO dbo.Users (id, username, email) OUTPUT INSERTED.id, INSERTED.username, INSERTED.email, INSERTED.created_at VALUES (@id, @username, @email)

list_orders.sql: SELECT id, user_id, amount, status, created_at FROM dbo.Orders WHERE user_id = @user_id ORDER BY id OFFSET @offset ROWS FETCH NEXT @limit ROWS ONLY

create_order.sql: INSERT INTO dbo.Orders (user_id, amount, status) OUTPUT INSERTED.id, INSERTED.user_id, INSERTED.amount, INSERTED.status, INSERTED.created_at VALUES (@user_id, @amount, @status)

count_orders.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM dbo.Orders WHERE user_id = @user_id
